Reviewed serial raw trajectory: local probing, integrated source implementation, component tests, and timeout.

parallel.requirements: Recognized that the required deliverable was an original behavioral reimplementation of the lz4 CLI based only on executing the provided binary and reading bundled docs.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Used a dynamic workflow to split behavioral exploration across many topic-specific child agents, while the parent later tried to implement core C source files.
parallel.implementation: Produced partial `xxh`, block, and HC source files, but did not finish a complete frame layer, CLI parser, build path, or final executable replacement.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The submitted artifact contains only partial library source plus workspace assets and the original executable; it omits the full frame/CLI implementation needed for evaluation.
parallel.verification: Children generated extensive behavioral notes, and the parent did some component work, but no integrated evaluator-aligned build/test loop completed before timeout.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out and official evaluation reports compile_failed with all 1829 tests not run; the artifact lacks the complete deliverable surface.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same executable-only reverse-engineering task and avoided delegation, workflows, web search, source lookup, and binary disassembly.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Kept probing and implementation in one local trajectory, moving from behavior exploration to `xxh32`, block codec, frame writer, and HC implementation.
serial.implementation: Wrote `xxh32`, `lz4blk`, `lz4frame`, and `lz4hc` source/header files and compared component frame outputs against the reference binary.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Delivered a more integrated source tree containing frame and component source files, though it still lacked a compiling final executable path.
serial.verification: Ran targeted local comparisons for hashes, frame output, block sizes, linked-block behavior, HC levels, and CLI behavior before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial run also timed out and official evaluation reports compile_failed with all tests not run; its implementation was incomplete despite broader assembly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the reverse-engineering-only constraint and encoded it in child rules before launching probes.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt and directly probed the executable and bundled docs without delegation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement misunderstanding separates the outcomes; the difference is how the implementation budget was allocated after recognizing requirements.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed behavior discovery into many topic children and a critic, leaving parent time for implementation after the broad probe.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept a single owner for probing, implementation, and component checks, with workflows disabled and zero subagents.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel allocation widened discovery far beyond the serial local path and left less closure capacity for indispensable assembly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child briefs carried common rules and topic-specific probes, but the outputs were behavioral notes rather than component interface contracts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained the behavioral facts and implementation interfaces in one context while moving through source files.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The contrast does not support a missing-context label; it supports a budget/allocation difference around how much probing was launched.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel started implementation work on `xxh`, block, and HC code but did not reach a complete frame/CLI source set in the artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote `xxh32`, `lz4blk`, `lz4frame`, and `lz4hc` source/header files and tested multiple layers locally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial reached a broader integrated implementation surface; parallel delivered a narrower partial library set.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow produced many child summaries, but the parent did not turn the broad probe results into a complete submitted implementation before timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial local results were immediately used in the same trajectory to write and test subsequent source layers.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a heavier result lifecycle from fan-out; serial avoided retrieval and synthesis overhead.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child probes used shared scratch locations and one child observed shared corpus mutation, but no final artifact contamination is proven.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed local scratch probing and wrote final source files without concurrent actors sharing the implementation tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Scratch interference was observed in parallel, but the concrete task-solving difference is artifact completeness rather than proven contaminated final code.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel gathered extensive probe validations but did not complete an integrated build/evaluator-aligned acceptance cycle.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed focused local component comparisons but likewise did not reach a passing official compile/evaluation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both lacked official acceptance; serial verified more implementation components, while parallel verified many behavior facts without complete assembly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 23 subagents, workflow-child tokens, 1032 tool calls, and timed out with an incomplete artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used zero subagents and also timed out, but its budget went into a single integrated implementation path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The key coordination difference is fan-out budget exhaustion in parallel, not a discordant official pass/fail result.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are not discordant: both parallel and serial have solution_passed false, error_code compile_failed, and 1829 tests not run. The concrete difference is that parallel spent much of the run on broad concurrent behavior probing and submitted a partial artifact lacking the frame/CLI layer, while serial locally implemented a broader source set including frame files but still failed to compile officially.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out across many probe topics consumed finite time and child-token budget.
Submitted artifact contains partial source files and omits the frame/CLI-facing implementation needed for a complete deliverable.
serial_contributors: Single-context implementation reached xxh32, block, frame, and HC source/header files.
Serial still timed out and failed compile evaluation, so its broader assembly was not enough for a passing solution.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial had a more integrated source tree than parallel.
Both attempts still had ordinary incompleteness and build-delivery defects leading to compile_failed.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Supported comparative contributor to artifact completeness, not an official outcome differential because both runs failed.

candidates.reason: The parallel parent did implement core source files itself after probing; the adverse event was budget consumed before full assembly, not absence of an implementer.
No separately completed component set was left without an integration owner; the parent remained the integrator but did not have enough closure budget.
The parent implicitly owned final assembly and wrote files into /workspace/src; the problem was broad fan-out exhausting time before frame and CLI assembly, not unassigned assembly.
The parent controlled the end-to-end path and artifact packaging; the missing compiled deliverable followed from unfinished implementation under timeout.
No single mandatory serial preflight blocked productive work; many probes ran concurrently and some implementation began during the run.
The investigation was parallel fan-out, not a deliberate first serial phase that had to finish before all implementation could start.
The indispensable path was starved, but the more specific directly evidenced episode is collective fan-out breadth and budget exhaustion.
The workflow enumerated many behavior areas and launched them in parallel; the run used 23 child logs and timed out before the indispensable frame/CLI deliverable was assembled.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel artifact contains only partial library sources and omits the frame layer and CLI-facing assembly that the serial attempt reached before its own compile failure.
candidates.near_match_reason: The critical path was affected, but the direct allocation boundary was collective breadth across many live probe children, so fan-out budget exhaustion is more specific.

candidates.reason: No single child assignment dominated the failure; the evidence shows many broad probe children collectively consuming the finite budget.
The child briefs included the executable-only rules, scratch guidance, topic scope, and exact-output requirement; no known requirement was omitted from a child brief and then followed.
The delegated work was behavioral probing, not separate components expected to interoperate through omitted file or API contracts.
There is no evidence that a known finding disappeared during transfer and caused repeated work or wrong action.
Child summaries were large, but the retained consequence is that the fan-out consumed the deadline before assembly, not a parent decision overloaded by one returned handoff.
No receiver acted on a superseded handoff; the final issue was incomplete implementation and packaging.
No incompatible child reports remained unadjudicated as the cause of the delivered artifact shape.
The parent did not make a visible whole-task completion acceptance decision; the run ended by timeout with an incomplete artifact.
No replacement child or retry repeated prior work without inherited checkpoint state.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: Some child trajectories were interrupted by timeout, but no parent or workflow explicitly stopped a needed active child before its result was finalized.
There was no complete promotable frame/CLI implementation or mutually compatible component set already ready for final placement.
There was no integrated verification step that was followed by a later merge without re-verification.
The delegated work was mainly probing and notes; no completed child implementation was retrievable and then unjoined into the final source tree.
Verifier-style findings were downstream of the same excessive fan-out episode; the aggregate return failure is better classified as fan-out budget exhaustion.
No required child failure or cancellation had a distinct scope that the parent visibly declined to resume outside the timeout chain.
The parent did receive substantial child summaries; the evidence does not show a concrete available result ignored at a decision point inconsistent with it.
The parent was actively writing implementation files and using results; the failure was not a passive wait without inspection.
Concurrent agents mostly probed behavior and wrote scratch notes, not competing source files or overlapping build ownership in the final tree.
No two live agents are shown editing the same submitted source or configuration file.
No non-entry source file produced by one live actor is shown being wholesale replaced by another.
No executable, entry-point source, or submitted artifact was replaced while another actor owned or used it.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced multiple current final outputs and invalidated provenance.
A shared scratch corpus was disturbed, but no final implementation workspace instability or provenance problem is proven beyond the more specific fan-out budget episode.
One child observed shared scratch mutation, but there is no evidence that another actor consumed that generated artifact as stable input for the final implementation or evaluation.

retained_patterns.reason: The workflow launched a wide behavioral-probe fan-out across many areas, used 23 child logs and heavy child-token/tool budget, then timed out before completing frame/CLI assembly.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: The parallel artifact lacks the frame layer and CLI-facing assembly while serial produced those source files before both runs failed official compile evaluation.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: This is not the residual generic critical-path label because the specific directly evidenced cause is collective breadth of live children exhausting budget.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Critical-Path Starvation, Missing Verifier Return, Late Finalization, and Blind Timeout Wait were treated as downstream or unsupported variants of the same timeout chain rather than separate retained episodes.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 32 L3 candidates were audited; no additional independent coordination boundary cleared the paired retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: Only the directly evidenced broad fan-out allocation episode is retained, avoiding multiple labels for the same timeout and incomplete-artifact chain.
